'''Anubis''' is a strange enemy that moves in the opposite direction that Link moves. It will phase through walls like ghosts. Anubis monsters were intended to be a more puzzle oriented enemy, but sadly their weakness to fire makes them trivial foes. 

== Actors ==
* {{actor ref|ovl_En_Anubice_Tag}} - Anubis enemy (actor spawned directly)
* {{actor ref|ovl_En_Anubice}} - Anubis enemy (actor indirectly spawned by above)
* {{actor ref|ovl_En_Anubice_Fire}} - Anubis's fire attack.
